post.description:
Create a remote bank account where exchanged crypto will be sent to in fiat. KYC is required.

**Important:** When providing third party details (`third_party_details`), the `recipient_first_name` and `recipient_last_name` fields must contain at least one letter. Names containing only digits are not accepted.

**USD accounts:** `transfer_method` is required (`ACH` for domestic ACH, `WIRE` for domestic Fedwire, or `INT_WIRE` for an international SWIFT wire). `ACH`/`WIRE` use `account_number` + `routing_number`; `INT_WIRE` uses `swift_code` plus exactly one of `account_number` or `iban` (no `routing_number`). When `recipient_type` is `THIRD_PARTY` and `transfer_method` is `WIRE` or `INT_WIRE`, `third_party_details` (recipient name + address) must be provided.

account_name.description: Alias for User Remote Bank Account

main_recipient.description: Setting this as true will set the account as the default off ramp bank account for a given user

account_details.description: Select account type based on currency: USD (ACH/Wire = Account+Routing, Int'l Wire = SWIFT + Account/IBAN), EUR (IBAN), GBP (Account+Sort), PKR (with customer details), INR (IFSC, SWIFT/BIC, bank name, remittance fields), TRY (IBAN), NGN (Account+Bank code), MXN/PHP/IDR/AED/OMR/QAR/GTQ (full remittance details), GHS (Mobile wallet or Bank account), BRL (PIX key), ARS (Account+Tax ID)
